items.title: Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent that can email, pay and book
items.title_zh: Meta推出个人智能体Muse：可代发邮件、支付与预订
items.summary_zh: Meta在美国推出个人AI代理Muse，可通过独立应用与WhatsApp连接邮箱、日历、支付、健康与智能家居，宣称运行于隔离的Secure VM并由Sentinel代理监督。Reuters称内部测试出现停滞与敏感数据未经授权上传等问题；产品在多州和解案余波中上线，信任门槛高于普通聊天机器人。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Meta rolled out on Tuesday a long-touted AI assistant that can autonomously send emails, sell a car and book travel on a person's behalf, despite internal concerns that the technology mismanages its access to sensitive personal data.
quotes.zh: Meta于周二推出期待已久的AI助手，可自主代用户发邮件、卖车与订旅行，尽管内部担忧该技术会不当处理敏感个人数据访问权限。

items.title: We built our house for LAN parties (2024)
items.title_zh: 我们把房子建成局域网派对场（2024）
items.summary_zh: 专为 LAN party 设计住宅的旧文再上首页，约400赞。评论羡慕成年后仍能撑起十余台机的朋友圈，并称文末 FAQ 很治愈。

quotes.author: elAhmo
quotes.en: Wholesome read. These guys are enjoying life and I loved reading the FAQ in the end, as well as them acknowledging they are very lucky!
quotes.zh: 读起来很温暖。这些人在享受生活，我也爱看文末 FAQ，以及他们承认自己很幸运！

quotes.author: swiftcoder
quotes.en: God, imagine having a big enough friend group as an adult to justify an 18-gaming-PC LAN. These folks are doing something right
quotes.zh: 天啊，想象一下成年后还有大到能撑起18台游戏电脑局域网趴的朋友圈。这帮人一定做对了什么。

items.title: James Talarico and Ken Paxton in dead heat in Texas Senate race
items.title_zh: 得州联邦参议员选战胶着：塔拉里科与帕克斯顿民调咬死
items.summary_zh: 多项民调显示民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科与共和党司法部长肯·帕克斯顿在得州联邦参议员选战中接近平手，Cook与Sabato均标为toss-up，成为2026中期最受关注战场之一。帕克斯顿在初选击败寻求连任的科宁后，民主党视翻盘长期红州席位为全国战略支点。

quotes.author: Newsweek / Overton Strategies
quotes.en: Democratic hopeful James Talarico and Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton are locked in a dead heat at 50 percent each in the race for the U.S. Senate in Texas.
quotes.zh: 民主党候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科与共和党司法部长肯·帕克斯顿在得州联邦参议员选战中以各50%陷入死热。

items.fetch_notes: NM 429；据Newsweek等公开民调报道估分5.3

items.title: TALA Is Open-Source
items.title_zh: TALA开源：布局算法站上阳光下
items.summary_zh: TALA 宣布开源，HN 约300赞。有人吐槽演示站在 iOS Safari 崩坏；亦有人细评图布局：部分图更整洁，Go 队列示例则分组与流向不如对照版。

quotes.author: pilgrim0
quotes.en: CSS must be the hardest technology out there, because people write these algorithms yet their site breaks completely on iOS safari on an iPhone SE2. Reminded me of when Linear’s CEO shared a post on Twitter bragging about how they only hired the best devs, and then I sent a screenshot of their homepage with a broken horizontal scroll. They dismissed it as a fault on my end for having an unsupported device. Turns out that a single CSS2 directive from 1998 fixed the issue (my OS is from 2022).
quotes.zh: CSS大概是最难的技术之一：人们能写出这些算法，站点却在 iPhone SE2 的 iOS Safari 上完全坏掉。让我想起 Linear CEO 分享过的类似槽点。

quotes.author: ricardobeat
quotes.en: The first few graphs are impressive, it does a much tidier job. The Go queue one is objectively worse - the other versions keep services and users grouped together, as well as a left-to-right flow. The TALA version makes it look more complicated than it is.
quotes.zh: 前几张图令人印象深刻，确实更干净。但 Go 队列那张客观上更差——其他版本把服务与用户分在一起，并保持从左到右的流向。

items.title: SpaceX Starship flight-test licensing slips toward late November, company says
items.title_zh: SpaceX称Starship试飞许可推迟至约十一月下旬
items.summary_zh: SpaceX更新称FAA给出的Starship试飞许可时间估计延至十一月下旬，较此前沟通的九月中旬推迟两个多月；公司强调并非新的安全问题，而是“多余的”环境分析。Starship进度牵动Starlink下一代卫星与公司宣传中的轨道算力构想，监管节奏再度成为发射频率瓶颈。

quotes.author: SpaceX
quotes.en: We recently received a launch license date estimate of late November from the FAA... This delay was not based on a new safety concern, but instead driven by superfluous environmental analysis.
quotes.zh: 我们最近收到FAA给出的发射许可时间估计为十一月下旬……此次延误并非基于新的安全关切，而是由多余的环境分析驱动。

items.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 图像能力更新讨论上榜，约265赞。重度 API 用户称最大体感是速度；亦有人用其重绘小说场景，讨论创作红利与市场稀释。

quotes.author: jjcm
quotes.en: I use gpt image 2 very heavily for my current project (ai UI design tool). The biggest improvement I'm seeing with this is in speed. I've generated around 50k images with gpt-image-2 via api, the the average latency has held at around 104s. It's wild how much of a difference this is - images are coming in at around 35-40s. Very noticable, and makes a difference when you're iterating quickly: https://jjcm.org/gpt-image-2.5-speed.mp4
quotes.zh: 我在当前项目（AI UI 设计工具）里重度使用 gpt image。这次最大改进是速度。我经 API 用 gpt-image-2 大概生成了五万张图……

quotes.author: meerita
quotes.en: I've really enjoyed using AI to generate images. For example, Long time ago, I read an amazing five-book saga called Riverworld, and I used AI to recreate many scenes, places, and ideas from the story. Seeing the books come to life through hundreds of images was a great experience. Definitely one of the coolest things to enjoy in 2026. Try it with your favorite books.
quotes.zh: 我很喜欢用 AI 生成图像。比如很久前读完《河世界》五部曲，就用 AI 重画许多场景、地点与设定。

items.title: DHS Border Patrol PITT units analyze financial habits to tip local traffic stops
items.title_zh: 美边境巡逻PITT小组据报用财务习惯向地方警察喂拦车线索
items.summary_zh: 404 Media披露边境巡逻队秘密单位Predictive Intelligence Targeting Teams（PITT）会审阅美国人财务活动等执法敏感数据，再向地方警察提供情报，使其以牌照遮挡等由头拦截并非因具体罪行被怀疑的驾驶者；与此前车牌识别预测项目相互印证。国会议员质疑无令状监控合法性，CBP拒答是否持有令状。

quotes.author: 404 Media
quotes.en: Border Patrol is running secretive predictive policing units that analyze Americans’ financial activity and other data, then feed that intelligence to local police who pull people over who are not suspected of any specific crime.
quotes.zh: 边境巡逻队正运行秘密预测性警务单位，分析美国人的财务活动等数据，再把情报交给地方警察，去拦停并未因任何具体罪行被怀疑的人。

items.title: This Month in Ladybird – August 2026
items.title_zh: Ladybird八月进展：独立浏览器引擎继续爬坡
items.summary_zh: Ladybird 发布2026年8月进展，HN 约275赞。有人惊喜 Twitch 已可工作，并称项目两年动能提升；新手追问引擎研发流程与实现门槛。

quotes.author: neuralkoi
quotes.en: I didn't expect to see Twitch working so soon! Ladybird seems to have received a nice boost in momentum in the past two years. If you've ever watched one of Andreas videos on YouTube you'll find he's incredibly driven and knowledgeable in this area. I can imagine someone like him would go from being a "10x programmer" to a "100x programmer" with AI assistance. I am not entirely sure to what degree AI is being leveraged to speed up development, but I am indeed happier I might be able to ditch FF
quotes.zh: 没想到这么快就能跑 Twitch！Ladybird 过去两年动能明显增强。如果你看过 Andreas 的 YouTube 视频，会发现他……

quotes.author: vivzkestrel
quotes.en: few stupid questions as always so that i can become a smarter person - what is the process of making a browser engine? what does the requirements look like - how is an actual html, css and javascript speification implemented at the code level? are we painting an empty canvas or is it more complicated - how is backward compatibility implemented? - is all the code written in c++ or is it rust these days? - how many people in a team do you need and how long would it take to write a browser engine f
quotes.zh: 照例问几个笨问题好让自己变聪明：做浏览器引擎的流程是什么？需求长什么样——真正的 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 引擎要怎么实现？

items.title: Tao: open math problems being non-renewably mined by AI
items.title_zh: 陶哲轩：开放数学问题正被AI“不可再生式”开采
items.summary_zh: 在OpenAI与Buckmaster围绕Navier–Stokes路径公开对峙之际，陶哲轩发文指出：哪怕只是有人在做某题的传闻，也可能触发海量AI算力抢先“压平”问题，从而逆向激励研究者不再分享有希望的方向。讨论把千禧年问题争议上升为科学共同体的信息分享与优先权制度危机。

quotes.author: Terence Tao
quotes.en: We have now seen that even the rumor of someone working on a problem can trigger a massive amount of AI-powered effort to flatten it before the original research project has time to reach its full potential.
quotes.zh: 我们现在看到，哪怕只是某人在研究某问题的传闻，也能触发海量AI算力，在原研究项目充分发挥潜力之前就把问题压平。

quotes.zh: 这片赛道明显在升温。英国的 Flux.ai 是在位者，Quilter、DeepPCB 也在秀布线演示；最近还有 OpenAI 的相关演示……
